faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Where exactly will the event be held?
faq.a1: The event will take place in Antalya. A 5-star premium facility will be selected for accommodation and the fair area, and details will be shared with our participants.
faq.a2: Our event is exclusive to travel agencies, tour operators, hotel representatives, and aviation industry professionals.
faq.a3: Participation for travel agencies and operators is by invitation. For partnership and booth applications, please visit our Partnership page.
faq.a4: As it is an international event, Turkish, Russian, German, and English are the official communication languages.
